name: meter
description: Cost per agent role, tool timing, context use and guard rules, above the prompt and in a pane

guards.title: Guard rules
guards.description: Advisory checks on top of your permission rules. Block a spawn that passes model, a git commit whose subject lacks [AI] or runs past 50 characters, skipping git hooks, and force push.

budgetUsd.title: Session budget (USD)
budgetUsd.description: Toast once when a session's spend passes this amount. 0 turns it off.

openPaneAtStart.title: Open the pane at start
openPaneAtStart.description: Open the meter pane when an interactive session starts. It shows when the terminal is at least 144 columns wide, or 110 once you have opened it yourself.
